Remove duplicate elements from a list.

my_list = [2, 4, 4, 2, 1, 1, 4, 3, 5, 5, 3]
print(list(set(my_list))) # fast, but order is lost
unique = []
for item in my_list: # keeps the original order
    if item not in unique:
        unique.append(item)
print(unique)
Note: A set cannot contain duplicates, which is why list(set(x)) works.
